name: – Commission proposal
title: Calculation of emission credits for heavy-duty vehicles for the reporting periods of the years 2025 to 2029 ***I
part_text:
Finland asked to change its recovery plan, the set of reforms and investments funded by the European Union. Some goals can no longer be met on time because of Russia's war in Ukraine, higher interest rates, slow procurement and lower demand for some projects. The plan also gets four small typing corrections. The European Commission agrees with the changes and proposes the Council approve them. The money Finland receives stays the same, about 1.95 billion euros.

- Five measures change: some deadlines move, two targets merge, two measures get better alternatives.
- It affects Finland's authorities and the projects and companies receiving this EU money.
- The Council must approve; then Finland continues the plan under the new goals.
